game: BAL@DAL Week 3 2026 | kickoff not saved | spread not saved | total not saved | weather not saved

script.base: No spread or total is saved, so the script is inferred from two weeks of form and the injury report. Baltimore should be able to move the ball on a Cowboys defense that has allowed 5.33 YPC and 8 runs of 10+ and is without both safeties, CB Cobie Durant and LB DeMarvion Overshown. Henry stays the engine (40 carries, 212 yards) with a short-area receiving role already in the data (4 targets, 38 yards, -14 air yards). Dallas cannot lean on Javonte Williams (24 carries, 71 yards, 2.96 YPC) against a Ravens front at 3.65 YPC, so Dak throws more when Baltimore blitzes (32% blitz, Dak EPA/db 0.19 vs blitz and 0.48 vs none).
script.flip1: Baltimore gets up and salts it with Henry on the ground. Henry rush volume rises, but his receiving touches can go to zero, and Dallas abandons the run so Javonte's carries fall further.
script.flip2: Dallas keeps it close or leads through the middle, where Baltimore has allowed 9.28 YPA on 18 attempts and 7 passes of 20+. Dallas stays pass-heavy anyway; the kill for the Javonte under is a committed rushing plan plus a long run, not a shootout.

injury_fallout: Known pre-kick from the nflverse injury report, not inactives: BAL LT Ronnie Stanley Out (toe) — rushing efficiency down, more quick throws, so RB/TE catches are the stated beneficiaries (Henry already the checkdown back; Andrews 13 targets / 98 yards is the pass-game volume piece). BAL WR Zay Flowers Questionable (hamstring), not ruled out — do not treat Moore/Bateman as confirmed sleepers; Flowers' log is 6 targets for 150 yards and he is off the card. DAL S Malik Hooker Out, S P.J. Locke Out, CB Cobie Durant Out, LB DeMarvion Overshown Out — underneath and intermediate coverage is on backups. That helps Henry's screens and Andrews more than a named outside WR. No replacement defenders are named in the pack. Final inactives (~90 min pre-kick) are not in the pack.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. Proxy only: Dallas YPA is flat by side (left 6.64 on 28, middle 7.18 on 11, right 6.88 on 25). Baltimore bleeds the middle (9.28 on 18) and holds the right (4.43 on 23).
matchup.pressure: Dallas blitzes 27%; Baltimore EPA/db is 0.22 vs blitz and 0.28 vs none, so pressure is not a Lamar kill. Baltimore blitzes 32%; Dak's EPA/db falls from 0.48 with no blitz to 0.19 when blitzed, which pushes Dallas off schedule and toward checkdowns rather than a healthy run game. Sack counts are not in the pack.
matchup.bleeds: Dallas run defense is the bleed: 5.33 YPC and 8 runs of 10+, plus Overshown out. Pass defense has no clean location hole. Baltimore is the opposite: 3.65 YPC and only 6 runs of 10+, but 7 explosive passes and a middle-of-field leak.
matchup.overlap: The carded overlap is not Henry's rush number (Stanley Out fights that). It is Henry's negative-air-yard targets into a linebacker-less Cowboys defense, and Javonte's rush attempts into a Ravens front that does not bleed. Lamb (17 targets, 226 air yards) and Pickens (14 targets, 187 air yards, only 68 yards) overlap Baltimore's middle/explosive leak, but neither is carded.

form: Two games only (weeks 1-2 totals, split by the prop logs). Henry rush 144 and 68 (40/212); receiving 19 and 19. Hill rush 18 and 6. Jackson 8/77 rush, prop log says no prior games — conflict, no leg. Andrews 49 and 49. Bateman 0 and 88. Flowers one logged 150, questionable. Moore 53 and 6. Javonte rush 41 and 30 (24/71); receiving 31 and 20; rush+rec 72 and 50. Dak rush 14 and 26. Lamb 44 and 153. Pickens 28 and 40 on 187 air yards. Flournoy 22 and 23. Ferguson 6 and 43. Demercado 7 and 8.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because Dallas played a one-score game, handed Javonte 17-18 carries, and one 18-yard run pushed him to 60-plus, while Baltimore led by three scores and Henry never saw a target — Hill and Andrews took the dumps and Henry finished at 4 receiving yards. The missing spread is what would have told us Dallas was live to run. A late Flowers or Stanley inactive change does not directly flip these two, but an uncharted Dallas plan to sell out on Henry in the pass game would.
slip_story: One story: Baltimore's front and Dallas's injuries, not a shootout stack. Javonte under wins if Dallas cannot run (base or pass-heavy flip). Henry receiving over wins if the quick game that Stanley's absence creates still finds the back once or twice. Do not add Henry rush over, a game under, or Lamb/Pickens overs — those need a different script. No bet is placed.
